description: This bar chart illustrates the Module FLOPs for different stages of an Audio back-end Conformer. The horizontal axis represents the Conformer Stage, labeled as “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)”, “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)”, and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)”, and the bars are arranged sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis represents Module FLOPs, labeled as “Module FLOPs”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. For each stage, there are three bars representing “grouped attention (g=3)”, “patch attention (k=3)”, and “feed-forward”, colored grey, orange, and green respectively. In Stage 1, the grey “grouped attention” bar reaches approximately 0.24, the orange “patch attention” bar reaches approximately 0.18, and the green “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.11. In Stage 2, the grey “grouped attention” bar reaches approximately 0.18, the orange “patch attention” bar reaches approximately 0.14, and the green “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.12. In Stage 3, the grey “grouped attention” bar reaches approximately 0.12, the orange “patch attention” bar reaches approximately 0.10, and the green “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.14. No bars are visually emphasized.
